name: RuneSpeak dragon bosses
source: Approved lightly detailed dragon designs from this chat; shape-language reference https://blog.duolingo.com/shape-language-duolingos-art-style/
prompt: Create a production animation sprite sheet derived faithfully from this approved dragon. EXACTLY SIX full-body poses in a precise 3 columns by 2 rows equal-cell grid, 1536x1024 canvas, each cell 512x512. Identity and restrained simple flat geometric style must match the reference: only broad belly plates, sparse two-tone accents, no detailed scales or extra spikes. Same size and LEFT-facing direction in every cell. Keep entire dragon wings horns tail and claws within each cell with generous padding, at least 30px from edges; no overlapping cells. Feet on matching baseline. Top row left to right: 1 idle threatening stance; 2 inhaling wind-up, head drawn back and chest expanded; 3 breath attack pose head thrust LEFT and mouth OPEN WIDE aimed left slightly downward. Bottom row left to right: 4 recovery exhaling jaw closing; 5 hurt recoiling with pained narrowed eyes; 6 defeated crouching collapsed low with closed eyes and folded wings if present. Poses must visibly differ while keeping limb count and anatomy intact. NO FIRE OR ACID drawn on this sheet: breath effects added separately by game renderer. No particles, glow, scenery, shadows, labels, text, borders, or divider lines. True clean transparent background.

events.hurt: Enemy retaliation: anticipation .08-.30, breath .30-.70 (reaches hero .40), recovery .70-.90, idle .90+.
events.enter: Idle; no travel needed for stationary ranged bosses.
events.reducedMotion: Static open-mouth pose and static beam during 100ms feedback; no lunge, bob or animated spray.

intentionalReuse: Idle is reused for enter and after recovery; boss enemies do not require loot or celebration poses.

breath.cindermaw: Orange/red fire with pale yellow core
breath.rimecoil: Blue fire with cyan and pale core
breath.vesperthorn: Lime-green liquid acid jet and round droplets

integration: Final lanes 0/1/2 respectively. 132 HP, 25 base retaliation damage, 90 base gold and mixed Spanish challenges unchanged. Existing saves regenerate final boss identities while preserving all progression fields.
framesNotes: Custom measured rectangles preserve full bodies across nominal cells. Frames use measured anchors and mouth emission points. Approved single-body images are used as final-route portraits.
validation: See dragon-browser-verification.json in delivery outputs for actual browser results.
